subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer insists they must go to the Prefect and inform him of what has happened.
source_quote: Calmer insists, “We must go to the Prefect and inform him of what has happened!”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asks why Terjon wants to keep a worthless rock.
source_quote: Zephyr smiles sweetly, “If this rock is so worthless, why keep it?”

subject: Terjon
fact: Terjon tosses the rock to Zephyr and admits it is worthless.
source_quote: Terjon mutters as it flies through the air, “You’re right. It is worthless.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realizes the militiamen have orders to bring the four to Burne and Refus.
source_quote: They are local militia members and have orders to bring the four to Burne and Refus, who are currently drinking at the Inn of the Welcome Wench.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne mutters in disbelief upon seeing the rock.
source_quote: Burne mutters, “This is it?”

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus reveals the blueprints are missing and returned with charcoal dust.
source_quote: Rufus whispers, “We may have a job for you. I was recently examining the blueprints for the keep and found them missing. My architect had no idea where they went. When I rechecked them later, they had returned, but there were traces of charcoal dust on them. I suspect that someone has copied our blueprints.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr thinks other than half the village, the secret is already out.
source_quote: Zephyr thinks, “Other than half the village.”

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler asks if the Druid likes the adventurers.
source_quote: “I also noticed that you didn’t talk to the Druid. Does the Druid not like you?”

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler informs the adventurers of the three-night minimum stay and sale policy for abandoned goods.
source_quote: “So that you know; adventurers have a minimum three-night stay at the Inn. And as a matter of policy, any goods left behind are sold after three days.”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo admonishes the adventurers to go deeper into the moathouse and find more evidence.
source_quote: “You must go deeper into the moathouse and find more evidence,” he admonishes.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia tells Jaroo the truth about who they’ve spoken to.
source_quote: Zinia realizes this town has no secrets, and he tells the truth.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter says the council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, Ostler, and Captain Zeb Fletcher.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter expects the adventurers to come to him first going forward.
source_quote: Therefore, going forward, I expect you all to come here first.

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler offers a job to prove Furnoc steals from guests, with free rooms as incentive.
source_quote: he explains that his job offer is to prove that Furnoc is a crook who steals from the Inn’s guests. To sweeten the pot, he offers free rooms for three nights.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia discovers the dice are loaded and declares it proof.
source_quote: As he picks them up, he realizes they are loaded—“The proof I needed!”

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo declares himself the person to help find the monster in the Gnarley forest.
source_quote: Elmo mutters, “I am your person!”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia overhears that Lysia wants to explore the ruined boathouse.
source_quote: Overhearing one pair, he learns that a farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse, but she needs some equipment and a few competent companions.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia overhears about a secret passage under the inn leading to four lost chambers.
source_quote: From another person, he hears, “There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.”

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir offers to join the party and split treasures if he gets first crack at arcane scrolls.
source_quote: I am offering to split the treasures as long as I get the first crack at any arcane scrolls we find.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir asks to join the quartet.
source_quote: I would like to go adventuring with you and complete your quartet. If you would have me?

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia says Spugnoir is very familiar.
source_quote: Sequoia laughs, “Somehow, you are very familiar.”

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey reports seeing cloaked people behind the brewery at midnight.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey fears the temple isn't as dead as everyone thought and suspects spies.
source_quote: the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought. And so maybe, those are, uh, spies.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr puts his sword to the throat of the smaller spy.
source_quote: Zephyr quickly advances on them, his sword in his right hand, and puts the blade to the throat of the smaller of the two—the spy shrieks.

subject: Jira
fact: Jira explains she and Marek are forbidden from being together due to religious conflict.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: Jira
fact: Jira pleads with Zinia to help them talk to their parents.
source_quote: Jira pleads with Zinia to help them and talk to their parents — “You’re heroes, and they’ll listen!”

subject: Airgid
fact: Airgid shouts “HOME!” as she recognizes her home near the Lotrimil mountains.
source_quote: The dragon suddenly shouts, “HOME!”

subject: Airgid
fact: Airgid promises her mommy will reward the heroes.
source_quote: Don’t worry, my mommy will reward you! I KNOW SHE WILL! THANK YOU!

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir accepts being left behind and says “Very well.”
source_quote: Spugnoir has that crushed look... He smiles, “Very well.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia points to the tower they ignored last time.
source_quote: Zinia points to the tower that they ignored last time.

subject: Sequoia and Zephyr
fact: Sequoia and Zephyr notice a faint gleam of coins on the tower floor.
source_quote: Looking at the floor, Sequoia and Zephyr notice a faint gleam of coins.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia finds an ivory box among the treasures.
source_quote: They find an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures.

subject: Elder Kenter's residence
fact: The residence has an eight-foot-high stone wall and a heavy gate.
source_quote: They open the gate and step inside. Looking around, Zinia quickly discovers that the compound has five families... It is the residence of some well-to-do folk and easily defensible in times of trouble.

subject: The Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: The inn has a secret passage below it leading to four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.
source_quote: From another person, he hears, “There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.”

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: Emiry Meadows contains a lost wizard laboratory.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: The Moathouse
fact: The moathouse contains a tower with collapsed upper portion and a courtyard with coins.
source_quote: The upper portion of the tower has collapsed, and the interior is dark. Looking at the floor, Sequoia and Zephyr notice a faint gleam of coins.

subject: The brewery
fact: Cloaked people have been seen lurking behind the brewery at midnight.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: The Gnarley Forest
fact: The Gnarley Forest is rumored to contain a monster.
source_quote: There is a monster in the Gnarley forest, and we will need someone to help us find it.

subject: The ruined boathouse
fact: The ruined boathouse is a place Lysia wants to explore.
source_quote: A farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse, but she needs some equipment and a few competent companions.

subject: Hawthorne
fact: Hawthorne is Elder Kenter’s second son with natural curiosity about unusual behavior.
source_quote: My second son, Hawthorne, saw you come from the moathouse. He followed you and saw you visited Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo is a drunk adventurer and ranger by profession.
source_quote: Sequoia realizes that this is Elmo. He also smells the stench of booze on him: “A drunk.”

subject: Furnoc
fact: Furnoc is accused of stealing from the Inn’s guests.
source_quote: Ostler explains that his job offer is to prove that Furnoc is a crook who steals from the Inn’s guests.

subject: Jakub
fact: Jakub is a member of the old faith and opposes Jira’s relationship with Marek.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek...

subject: Tomlyn
fact: Tomlyn is the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert, and Marek’s father.
source_quote: ...Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: Captain Zeb Fletcher
fact: Captain Zeb Fletcher is on the council and father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.
source_quote: Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: Kenter
fact: Kenter is the village elder with uncommon wisdom.
source_quote: Standing in the middle of the room is an older man with white hair who looks reasonably fit and whose eyes show uncommon wisdom.

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler is the innkeeper who enforces the three-night stay policy.
source_quote: Ostler, the innkeeper, sits at the table — “I see Burne and Rufus like you.”

subject: Jira
fact: Jira is a teenager who wants to be with Marek despite religious conflict.
source_quote: The girl introduces herself as Jira...

subject: Marek
fact: Marek is a teenager whose father is Tomlyn and who is forbidden from being with Jira.
source_quote: The boy introduces himself as Marek.

subject: The blueprints' true origin
fact: The blueprints returned with charcoal dust, but their true origin and the identity of the copier remain unknown.
source_quote: Rufus whispers, “We may have a job for you... I suspect that someone has copied our blueprints.”

subject: The cloaked figures' identity
fact: The cloaked people behind the brewery are suspected to be spies, but their allegiance and purpose are unconfirmed.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight... maybe, those are, uh, spies.

subject: The dragon's mommy
fact: Airgid promises her mommy will reward the heroes, but her mommy's identity and whereabouts are unspecified.
source_quote: Don’t worry, my mommy will reward you! I KNOW SHE WILL! THANK YOU!

subject: The temple's true state
fact: Rumors suggest the temple isn't as dead as believed, but its current condition and activity are unverified.
source_quote: the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought.

subject: The lost wizard's identity
fact: The wizard whose laboratory is under Emiry Meadows and whose chambers lie below the inn is unnamed and unknown.
source_quote: an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.

subject: The bandit-saboteur connection
fact: Rufus suspects the thief worked with the bandits, but the exact identity and location of the saboteur remain hidden.
source_quote: I am convinced it is one of the workers in the encampments.

subject: The Druid's opinion
fact: Ostler questions whether the Druid likes the adventurers, but the Druid’s actual feelings are never stated.
source_quote: “I also noticed that you didn’t talk to the Druid. Does the Druid not like you?”

subject: The stone's true nature
fact: The stone found on the bandit's body was dismissed as worthless, but its origin and potential magical properties remain unexamined.
source_quote: Terjon says, “I would like to keep this worthless rock.”

subject: The secret of the ivory box
fact: The ivory box found in the tower is recovered, but its contents and significance are not yet revealed.
source_quote: They find an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures.

subject: The identity of the cloaked figures
fact: The two teenagers Jira and Marek were mistaken for spies, but their true identity as forbidden lovers was only revealed after confrontation.
source_quote: The girl introduces herself as Jira, and the boy as Marek.

subject: The fate of the blueprints' original creator
fact: The architect who lost the blueprints has no idea where they went, and their fate remains unknown.
source_quote: My architect had no idea where they went.

subject: Kenter
fact: Kenter toasts, “The Blessings of Beory.”
source_quote: When the Elder gets his glass, he coughs and toasts, “The Blessings of Beory.”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia mutters that they should talk to the village elder.
source_quote: “We should go talk to the village elder,” mutters Zinia.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia notices how two sons carefully groom the horses.
source_quote: Sequoia notices how two sons carefully groom the horses.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr smiles and says “No problem.” when offered the job to catch Furnoc.
source_quote: Zephyr smiles, “No problem.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr falls on the table to create a distraction.
source_quote: So he falls on the table that Furnok is sitting on, causing the table to tip over.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia grabs the dice and declares them loaded.
source_quote: Zinia moves quickly and grabs the dice. As he picks them up, he realizes they are loaded—“The proof I needed!”

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo shouts, “Get out of here, Furnok, or I’ll have to call the Captain.”
source_quote: A burly, muscular man sitting at another table shouts, “Get out of here, Furnok, or I’ll have to call the Captain, and he won’t be as kindly as Ostler is.”

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir says, “Tomorrow then, as it is quite late!”
source_quote: “Tomorrow then, as it is quite late!”

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey whispers, “Rumor has it that you are the right people to go to if there is a problem.”
source_quote: a young man walks up to them and whispers, “Rumor has it that you are the right people to go to if there is a problem.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asks, “What’s going on?” after capturing the spies.
source_quote: And then he asks, “What’s going on?”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia snarls, “Go away.”
source_quote: Zinia snarls and tells them to go away.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia struggles to sleep thinking about Zephyr and the teenagers.
source_quote: Sequoia struggles to sleep as he thinks about Zephyr looking confused and the two teenagers squealing.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer asks, “What do we want to check out?”
source_quote: Inside the courtyard, Calmer asks, “What do we want to check out?”

subject: The Duke
fact: The Duke says, “I hope I see you again.”
source_quote: “I hope I see you again.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr hands over the rock to Burne and Rufus.
source_quote: Zephyr hands over the rock.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia says, “Of course.”
source_quote: Zephyr thinks, “Other than half the village.” And then he says, “Of course.”

subject: Kenter

source_quote: he turns to the trio and says in a grandfatherly voice, “It is good that you came here.”

subject: Kenter
fact: Kenter says, “Don’t worry,” to Sequoia’s silent protest.
source_quote: Sequoia is tempted to protest, but Kenter continues, “Don’t worry, whenever anyone does something out of the ordinary...”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia mutters, “Well, that was interesting.”
source_quote: “Well, that was interesting,” mutters Zinia.
